recovery_artifacts.note: git archive of the locked commit (tracked files only, MIT license included); contains no quota snapshots, credentials or build output
single-commit snapshot of the locked commit (shallow, no parents); it cannot be fetched for history. The tool reads it by unpacking objects and archiving the locked commit

provenance.pin_evidence: the commit is upstream's release commit `chore: release v1.6.3` (#129) in the owned fork, read once with a read-only clone; the renamed plugin id herdr-agent-usage (commit 7cdb248) and the snapshot files and `refresh` action the supervisor consumes were reviewed at this revision; the tree id, critical-file hashes and content manifest were recomputed from the archive with this tool's own verifier
provenance.replaces: 809749e585480047e502df072fb8ddccc4719d4e (manifest 1.5.4, plugin id herdr-agent-quota): the earlier pin predates the rename, so the supervisor's default quota path and refresh command named a plugin id it did not provide
provenance.not_used: fork main (4d6e54b, 1.6.3 plus later unreleased commits) is not a supported revision; moving the pin needs a reviewed change to this file
provenance.build_note: the plugin's own manifest runs `cargo build --release`; the supported preparation builds with --locked against the hashed Cargo.lock. This revision adds the zstd crate (C compiler needed) and Cursor and Muse providers whose network use and credential reads are listed in docs/QUOTA_DEPENDENCY.md
